privacy_subtitle: Exactly what data Mongez collects, why we collect it, and the control you have over it.
privacy_intro_body: This policy applies to the Mongez mobile app and the Mongez website. It explains what we process when you create an account, book a home service or simply browse. We only collect what is needed to connect you with technicians and run the service safely.
privacy_account_body: When you register (by phone number or with your Google account) we store:
privacy_account_b1: Full name, phone number and email address
privacy_account_b2: Profile picture, when you sign in with Google
privacy_account_b4: Your saved service addresses and your preferred language
privacy_media_body: To explain a problem clearly you can attach photos and a short voice recording to an order (up to 4 images and 1 recording per order).
privacy_media_b1: Files are uploaded to and stored on Cloudinary, our media hosting provider
privacy_media_b2: They are only used to help the assigned technician understand and handle your request
privacy_media_b3: We remove these files as part of processing your account deletion request
privacy_id_body: This section applies to technicians only (not clients). To verify your identity, our team requests a photo of your national ID card.
privacy_id_b1: We receive the photo and store it inside our system — it is not uploaded from inside the app at present
privacy_id_b2: It is used only for the internal admin team's review and account approval, and is not shared with any third party
privacy_push_body: The app registers a device token with Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) so we can send you notifications about your orders.
privacy_push_b1: The token identifies your app installation, it is not used to track you across other apps or websites
privacy_push_b2: You can turn notifications off at any time from your phone settings
privacy_crash_body: We use Firebase Crashlytics to collect crash and error reports so we can fix bugs and improve app stability.
privacy_crash_b1: Reports contain technical details such as device model, OS version and the error stack trace
privacy_crash_b2: Crash collection is switched off while the app runs in debug mode
privacy_location_body: Mongez does not collect location data. The app does not request GPS permission and does not read your device coordinates. The address you enter yourself (governorate, city and street) is the only location information we use.
privacy_share_body: We never sell your personal data. It is shared only with the providers required to run the service:
privacy_share_b1: Google / Firebase — sign-in, push messaging (FCM) and crash reports (Crashlytics)
privacy_share_b2: Cloudinary — hosting for order photos and voice notes
privacy_share_b3: Authorities, only when we are legally required to
privacy_retention_body: Account data is kept for as long as your account is active. Crash reports are kept only as long as needed for support and improving app stability.
privacy_rights_body: You can ask us to delete your account and all personal data linked to it at any time. Send the request from the email registered on your account to:
privacy_rights_b1: Email {{email}} with your phone number or account email and the word "Delete my account"
privacy_rights_b2: Update your name, contact details and addresses anytime from the profile screen
privacy_rights_b3: We answer every privacy request as soon as possible and at the latest within 30 days
privacy_contact_body: For any question about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, contact us at:
privacy_delete_body: You can delete your account and its personal data at any time. Start the request from the app, or open the deletion page directly.
delacc_subtitle: How to delete your Mongez account: what gets removed, what we keep, and what happens next.
delacc_removed_body: This is applied to your account and everything tied to it:
delacc_removed_b1: Your name, phone number, email address and home address
delacc_removed_b2: Your profile picture and your national ID card photo
delacc_removed_b3: Your saved addresses, notifications and registered device tokens
delacc_removed_b4: Photos and voice notes you attached to your own orders
delacc_kept_body: Some records outlive your account because someone else depends on them:
delacc_kept_b1: Orders and their history, so a technician keeps a record of work already done
delacc_kept_b2: Reviews you left, so the technician's rating is not erased by your leaving
delacc_kept_b3: Commission and payment records, which we must keep for accounting
delacc_retention_body: Your personal data is deleted as soon as you confirm — nothing that identifies you is kept after that. Order history, reviews and commission records stay in anonymised form with no set end date, so a technician keeps a record of the work and our accounting records stay complete.
delacc_note_body: Keeping these means your account is deactivated and stripped of personal data rather than removed row by row. Nothing that identifies you is left behind.
delacc_checkbox: I understand that this is permanent and cannot be undone
delacc_done_body: Your personal data has been removed. You have been signed out — if the app is still open on your phone, close it and reopen it.
delacc_error_body: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
delacc_active_orders: You still have {{count}} order(s) in progress. Finish or cancel them first, then come back here.
delacc_no_token_title: Open this page from the app
delacc_no_token_body: To keep your account secure, deletion has to be started from inside the Mongez app: open Settings and tap "Delete my account". That passes a single-use link to this page.
delacc_no_token_email: If you no longer have the app, email us from the address registered on your account and we will process the request for you.
